reviews.title: VERY GOOD QUALITY FOR PRICE
reviews.comment: I’ve been using the JBL Quantum 100M2 for a while now, and for the price, it’s honestly one of the best budget gaming headsets out there. The sound quality really surprised me. With JBL’s signature audio, you can clearly hear everything from footsteps to in-game effects, which actually makes a difference when you’re gaming. It feels immersive and way more detailed than you’d expect at this price point. Comfort is another big win. The headset is lightweight and comes with memory foam ear cushions, so it doesn’t feel heavy or uncomfortable even during longer gaming sessions. It’s not trying to be ultra-premium, but for what you’re paying, it’s realistically very comfortable and easy to wear for hours.
reviews.author: CHASE

reviews.title: MIC DOES WORK!!! PLEASE READ
reviews.comment: At first, I thought this headset had low mic quality, but all I had to do was plug the mic into the headphones before plugging it into a device for the mic to work. Unplug it and plug it back into the device a few times if the mic doesn't work afterwards. Headphone quality is amazing.
reviews.author: Dee Zhaee

reviews.title: Buy these headphones they’re perfect
reviews.comment: Impressive sound quality and feel. I’m using these for zoom meetings. People usually have a hard time hearing me, I’m a soft talker. But this one picks up everything I say and amplifies it. It’s cushiony and comfortable too. I LOVE them.
reviews.author: cynthia

reviews.title: Good headset. Better Value
reviews.comment: It’s a great headset for the price. You’re getting what you pay for. A nice headset at a great value. Don’t let the price scare you. It’s worth the money, feels cheap but isn’t.
reviews.author: CuzzyWuzzyMarriedAMuzzy

reviews.title: Great Gaming Headset
reviews.comment: This is a great pair of gaming headphones if you’re trying to save some money and get good quality. Microphone sounds clear, audio quality is great, the material feels durable, the price is good, the material feels durable, and it’s compatible with PC and console. The only downside about this is how thin the wire is so be careful with yanking or getting it stuck to a door knob. Other than that, great quality gaming headset for less than $40 and I recommend getting these while on sale so you can save even more.
